Horla is the Avatar, master of all four emotions. Anger. Fear, Sadness, Joy. You are put in a Stance whenever you trigger Leap. Leap is triggered on the first card that is played each turn if they have a “Leap” effect written on it. In this case, all of Horla’s cards have a “Leap” effect, putting you in a different emotional state.

Her basic attack puts you in Anger. This stance increases your DMG on attacks that are hitting the enemy.

Her basic defend puts you in Sadness. This stance increases your healing and shielding.

Her 0 cost skill gives Aliemus and puts you in Joy. This stance increases the Aliemus gained of all Awakeners, Retains your Whole Hand and unsued Arithma as long as you are in Joy stance.

Her 2 cost skill gives you STR and Lowers enemy STR, and puts you in Fear. This stance increases the STR, Counter, Poison you gain/apply. 

When in a stance, you stay in that stance FOREVER, in between battles as well. You only change or “lose” the stance when you trigger another stance. 

Her Exalt gives STR, Crit Rate and Crit Dmg, Healing, Aliemus to all Awakeners. Depending on the stance, certain aspects give more. Anger gives more CR and CD. Sadness(Grief) gives more Healing. Fear gives more STR. Joy gives more Aliemus. The Exalt further empowers the passive effects of the stance for 1 turn.

Her Rouse makes it so after staying in one stance for a turn, every other stance card gains an additional effect stacking up to three turns. The additional effect procs on Leap, but will make you switch your stance if played. The basic attack with Anger stance makes it hit multiple times. The basic defense with Sadness heals you. The 0 cost with Joy gives more Aliemus. The 2 cost with Fear gives more STR.

Horla stance passives scale off DR(Death Res). More DR means stronger % effect of your stance’s passive effects. Anger gives X% more DMG. Sadness gives X% more healing and shielding. Joy gives X% more Aliemus. Fear gives X% more STR/Counter/Poison.
